full_judgment: 25. The trial court discussed the plaintiff's claim that the predecessor of the plaintiff Asmat Ali Zomadder was the owner of the suit land. After auction, Samacharan Mukhapaddaya obtaining kabuliyat from Asmat Ali Zomadder possessing the suit land. Thereafter, Samacharan Mukhapaddaya again leased out the suit land to Asmat Ali Zomadder and RS record was in the name of Asmat Ali Zomadder.
